messages:
luis (billing): Heads-up Asterion Labs (acct_4721) - INV-2026-411 tried card on file 3x and all failed. Customer asked for wire to avoid suspension. Can we send instructions and waive late fee if same-day? @priya?

sam (rev-ops): How big is the invoice and original due date? Any previous late fee waivers for this account?

luis (billing): $8,720. Due 2026-04-02. No prior waivers on record. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/INV-2026-411

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 3 attempts (2026-04-01T09:12:03Z, 09:18:47Z, 09:36:22Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; error_detail: processing_error

priya (finance): We prefer one last soft retry (CVV prompt) for soft declines if customer can confirm details. If they insist on wire, finance is okay to waive a single late fee for a first emergency wire for mid-market accounts but need the compliance check on origin bank. @compliance-bot?

nate (acct-mgr): I just spoke with their billing ops. They say their AP team is already initiating an outbound wire. They asked for formal instructions and contact to send the payment receipt. I'll wait on the exact wording before emailing.

luis (billing): Bank block for email template (paste into message):
```
Bank: Meridian Trust Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account Number: 9876543210
Routing (ACH/ABA): 026009593
SWIFT: MTBKUS44
Reference: INV-2026-411 / Asterion Labs (acct_4721)
```
Please tell them to attach a screenshot or swift MT103 and send to billing@redwood.ai.

compliance-bot: compliance_check_required: confirm origin bank matches KYC on file AND verify beneficiary name consistency. If origin bank differs, require two additional KYC docs (bank statement + AP contact verification).

priya (finance): Compliance okay with conditional waiver: waive $50 late fee if proof of wire is received and treasury confirms funds within 72h AND origin bank matches KYC. Make a note in account and tag compliance when marking paid.

sam (rev-ops): Post-wire steps: once treasury emails confirmation, set payment method to 'bank_transfer' in Billing UI, run usage reconciliation for the billing period, and trigger the payment-received webhook to their tenant.

nate (acct-mgr): Email sent with instructions + template. Snippet used: "Please initiate the wire using the details below and reply with the transfer confirmation (screenshot or SWIFT MT103). We will hold suspension for 72 hours pending receipt of funds."

luis (billing): Moving INV-2026-411 to "awaiting wire". I'll waive late fee after treasury confirmation and attach the MT103. Marking action items for treasury and rev-ops. :white_check_mark:
